rawFindings.title: Incorrect regular expression for OPT_OUT_PATTERN
rawFindings.explanation: The OPT_OUT_PATTERN regex was changed from `/[\[\(\/\+\-]/` to `/^[-[(\/+]$/`. The original regex matches any of the characters '[', '(', '/', '+', '-', anywhere within the string (usually a token value). The new regex matches exactly one character that is one of '-', '[', '(', '/', '+', and anchors to start and end of string (`^...$`). This means it will not match multi-character tokens like '++' or '--' or '+=' anymore. However, this stricter match likely breaks the intended behavior because s
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the OPT_OUT_PATTERN regex to the original `/[\[\(\/\+\-]/` to match any of the listed characters anywhere in the token value, ensuring proper detection of opt-out tokens.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Input: Source code including '++' or '--' operators immediately after semicolons. The rule mistakenly treats these as requiring semicolons or reports missing semicolons incorrectly due to the faulty regex mismatch.
